title: trade_list row
description: Private input contract v1 (docs/architecture/08_PRIVATE_ADAPTER_INTERFACE.md §10; since 1.8). One live or cancelled trade of a book as the adapter lists it, without the trade's terms: the list the monitor compares with the terms it holds to ask only for the new and changed trades. A stock: in force until a newer list of the book. An optional field may be absent or null (the same thing); the empty string is invalid everywhere. Raw firm values go in x_* keys; _src is the row's location in the report, without sheet names.

int.description: an integer: a JSON integer or a string of digits; normalised to an integer
